_why: RULE-2026-11-13-B: a review class runs Sonnet only with a no-worse quality receipt. Founder, 2026-11-15: 'Decide on the model according to how well it does'. sancho was on claude-sonnet-5 before this measurement; this records the result that moved it to Opus. No receipt was written because Sonnet measured worse. test_sancho_agent.py reads decision_model from this file, so the agent's model cannot drift from the measured decision with the tests green.

arms.opus: the Agent tool's opus alias, which model-routing.json records as resolving to claude-opus-5-5

method: 12 real malware/attribution case findings, each with one inserted 'Key judgment' section carrying 2 planted defects (24 total: one-indicator naming, header timestamp as proof, fuzzy hash as identity, packer or commercial infrastructure as attribution, vendor label as T1, timing as causation, invented numbers, out-of-scope detonation or contact). Each model reviewed every sample from the text alone. Reviews were shuffled to X/Y with a fixed seed and graded by one blind Opus judge against the answer key. Case content stays in the private eval directory, not in this repo.

results.sonnet_miss: s01.d2: did not name RC4 as a generic cipher when a nationality was inferred from it
